<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="25" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="20" x2="315" y2="24" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="18" x2="320" y2="24" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="16" x2="325" y2="24" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="21" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="21" x2="342" y2="21" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="353" y="15" width="22" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="355" y="17" width="16" height="7" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="376" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle back and brand mark -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,61 26,69 34,77" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="68" r="18" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">n</text>
  </g>

  <!-- heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="126" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Create an account</text>
    <text x="24" y="153" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Stay informed with news that matters to you.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- username field -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="180" width="342" height="70" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
  </g>
  <text x="36" y="202" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">USERNAME</text>
  <text x="36" y="229" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">alex.morgan</text>
  <circle cx="346" cy="215" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#00BA88" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="341,215 345,219 352,211" fill="none" stroke="#00BA88" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- password field -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="266" width="342" height="70" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
  </g>
  <text x="36" y="288" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">PASSWORD</text>
  <text x="36" y="315" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="2px" fill="#E4E6EB">••••••••••</text>
  <g>
    <path d="M337 302 Q346 292 355 302 Q346 312 337 302" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="302" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="292" x2="355" y2="312" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- support row -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="356" width="20" height="20" rx="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <polyline points="29,366 33,370 40,362" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="371" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Remember me</text>
    <text x="366" y="371" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="400" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="432" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Login</text>
  </g>

  <!-- divider -->
  <g>
    <line x1="24" y1="480" x2="164" y2="480" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="226" y1="480" x2="366" y2="480" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="485" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">or continue with</text>
  </g>

  <!-- social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="506" width="164" height="50" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <path d="M105 518 C99 518 96 522 96 528 L96 532 L92 532 L92 538 L96 538 L96 546 L102 546 L102 538 L107 538 L108 532 L102 532 L102 529 C102 527 103 526 105 526 L108 526 L108 518 Z" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="135" y="537" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="506" width="164" height="50" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <path d="M221 520 L221 528 L229 528" fill="none" stroke="#4285F4" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M229 520 L235 520 L235 526" fill="none" stroke="#34A853" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M235 526 L235 534 L229 534" fill="none" stroke="#FBBC05" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M229 534 L221 534 L221 528" fill="none" stroke="#EB4335" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="275" y="537" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- account prompt -->
  <g>
    <text x="143" y="596" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Already have an account?</text>
    <text x="151" y="596" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Sign in</text>
    <line x1="151" y1="599" x2="196" y2="599" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- lower reassurance content -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="631" width="342" height="54" rx="6" fill="#25282C"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="658" r="13" fill="#00BA88" opacity=".18"/>
    <polyline points="42,658 47,663 55,653" fill="none" stroke="#34EAB9" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="655" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Your privacy matters</text>
    <text x="72" y="672" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">We keep your account details secure.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#25282C"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="49" cy="792" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="53,788 50,796 44,798 47,790" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
      <text x="49" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="195,781 183,790 207,790" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="186" y="789" width="18" height="13" rx="2" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="193" y="795" width="5" height="7" fill="#1C1E21"/>
      <text x="195" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- bookmark -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="290,781 306,781 306,803 298,798 290,803" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="298" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="349" cy="788" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="349" cy="800" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="349" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
